'''Greyor Frenn''' is a man of the [[Two Rivers]] in the army of Lord [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Activities==
On the [[Jehannah Road]] in [[Ghealdan]], Greyor Frenn is one of the Two Rivers men who huddles around the campfire, along with [[Wil al'Seen]] and [[Jon Ayellin]]. He sits near Queen [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]], Lady [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]], and [[Elyas Machera]], occassionally glancing at Perrin as he grieves for [[Hopper]].{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Greyor Frenn is named after Gregory Frenette, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
